item.title: Columbia re-opens campus 2 years after anti-Israel protests prompted lockdowns
item.description: Columbia University has reopened its campus after two years of turmoil following pro-Palestinian protests. Meanwhile, one Jewish student says there's still a need to discipline faculty who supported the discrimination.

item.title: Santa Clara law school offers scholarships after Trump capped student loans
item.description: At least one law school is already lowering tuition in reaction to Trump's new budget bill.

item.title: New book shows how academic medicine and medical schools are ‘doing great harm’
item.description: A new book provides the average reader with the facts about DEI and gender ideology in medicine - and why that is harmful.

item.title: Students allege discrimination for ‘Jewish sounding’ last names at Chapman U.
item.description: Two Chapman University graduates filed a federal lawsuit alleging discrimination based on their Jewish identities. They claim the university failed to address ongoing antisemitism, including harassment from Students for Justice in Palestine.

item.title: Florida bill would cap number of foreign students at public universities
item.description: A Florida bill aims to limit foreign students at public universities to 10% of their total enrollment.
